1: // Game based on IDEA.md – Space Drift
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas){ console.error('Canvas #game not found'); return; }
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Simple sound engine using Web Audio API
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   // Ensure audio starts after first user interaction
9:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
10:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
11:   }, {once: true});
12:   function playSound(freq, duration, type='sine', volume=0.1){
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = type;
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     osc.start();
21:     setTimeout(()=>{ osc.stop(); }, duration);
22:   }
23:   // Convenience wrappers
24:   function beep(freq, duration){ playSound(freq, duration, 'sine', 0.1); }
25:   function explosion(){ playSound(150, 400, 'triangle', 0.2); }
26:   function spawnAsteroidSound(){ playSound(300, 80, 'square', 0.05); }
27:   function fuelLow(){ playSound(100, 200, 'sawtooth', 0.08); }
28:   // full‑window canvas
29:   function resize(){
30:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
31:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
32:   }
33:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
34:   resize();
35: 
36:   // Input handling
37:   const keys = {};
38:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
39:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
40: 
41:   // Ship definition
42:   const ship = {
43:     x: canvas.width/2,
44:     y: canvas.height/2,
45:     angle: 0,
46:     radius: 10,
47:     speed: 0,
48:     maxSpeed: 4,
49:     thrust: 0.1,
50:     drag: 0.02
51:   };
52: 
53:   // Stars background with twinkle
54:   const stars = [];
55:   for(let i=0;i<100;i++) stars.push({
56:     x: Math.random()*canvas.width,
57:     y: Math.random()*canvas.height,
58:     size: Math.random()*2+1,
59:     alpha: Math.random()*0.5+0.5
60:   });
61: 
62:   // Asteroids
63:   const asteroids = [];
64:   function spawnAsteroid(){
65:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
66:     let x,y,vx,vy;
67:     const radius = Math.random()*15+10;
68:     const speed = Math.random()*1.5+0.5;
69:     if(edge===0){ x=0; y=Math.random()*canvas.height; vx=speed; vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; }
70:     else if(edge===1){ x=canvas.width; y=Math.random()*canvas.height; vx=-speed; vy=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; }
71:     else if(edge===2){ x=Math.random()*canvas.width; y=0; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; vy=speed; }
72:     else { x=Math.random()*canvas.width; y=canvas.height; vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*speed; vy=-speed; }
73:     asteroids.push({x,y,vx,vy,radius});
74:     spawnAsteroidSound(); // audio cue
75:   }
76:   // initial asteroids
77:   for(let i=0;i=0;i<5;i++) spawnAsteroid();
78: 
79:   let score=0;
80:   let fuel=100; // percent
81:   let lastTime=0;
82:   const fuelDrainRate=0.02; // per ms
83: 
84:   function update(dt){
85:     // twinkle stars
86:     stars.forEach(s=>{
87:       s.alpha += (Math.random()-0.5)*0.05;
88:       if(s.alpha<0.3) s.alpha=0.3;
89:       if(s.alpha>1) s.alpha=1;
90:     });
91:     // input
92:     if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w']){
93:       ship.speed = Math.min(ship.maxSpeed, ship.speed + ship.thrust);
94:       beep(600, 80); // thrust sound
95:     }
96:     if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['s']) ship.speed = Math.max(0, ship.speed - ship.thrust);
97:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']) ship.angle -= 0.05;
98:     if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']) ship.angle += 0.05;
99: 
100:     // apply drag
101:     ship.speed *= 1-ship.drag;
102:     // move ship
103:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle)*ship.speed;
104:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle)*ship.speed;
105:     // wrap around edges
106:     if(ship.x<0) ship.x+=canvas.width; if(ship.x>canvas.width) ship.x-=canvas.width;
107:     if(ship.y<0) ship.y+=canvas.height; if(ship.y>canvas.height) ship.y-=canvas.height;
108: 
109:     // update asteroids
110:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
111:       const a=asteroids[i];
112:       a.x+=a.vx; a.y+=a.vy;
113:       // wrap
114:       if(a.x<0) a.x+=canvas.width; if(a.x>canvas.width) a.x-=canvas.width;
115:       if(a.y<0) a.y+=canvas.height; if(a.y>canvas.height) a.y-=canvas.height;
116:       // collision with ship
117:       const dx=a.x-ship.x, dy=a.y-ship.y;
118:       const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
119:       if(dist<a.radius+ship.radius){
120:         // collision - explosion sound then game over
121:         explosion();
122:         alert('Game Over! Score: '+Math.floor(score));
123:         document.location.reload();
124:         return;
125:       }
126:     }
127:     // spawn new asteroids over time
128:     if(Math.random()<dt*0.001) spawnAsteroid();
129: 
130:     // fuel consumption
131:     fuel -= dt*fuelDrainRate;
132:     if(fuel<=0){ alert('Out of fuel! Score: '+Math.floor(score)); document.location.reload(); return; }
133:     // low fuel warning sound (once per low threshold)
134:     if(fuel<20 && !window._lowFuelWarned){
135:       fuelLow();
136:       window._lowFuelWarned = true;
137:     }
138:     if(fuel>=20){ window._lowFuelWarned = false; }
139: 
140:     score += dt*0.01; // increase score over time
141:   }
142: 
143:   function draw(){
144:     // background gradient (deep space)
145:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
146:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0,'#0b001e');
147:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1,'#001');
148:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
149:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
150:     // stars with twinkle effect
151:     stars.forEach(s=>{
152:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha})`;
153:       ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,s.size,s.size);
154:     });
155:     // ship
156:     ctx.save();
157:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
158:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
159:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.moveTo(15,0);
162:     ctx.lineTo(-10,10);
163:     ctx.lineTo(-10,-10);
164:     ctx.closePath();
165:     ctx.fill();
166:     ctx.restore();
167:     // asteroids with radial gradient
168:     asteroids.forEach(a=>{
169:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius*0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
170:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
171:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
172:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
173:       ctx.beginPath();
174:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI*2);
175:       ctx.fill();
176:     });
177:     // HUD
178:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
179:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
180:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+Math.floor(score),10,20);
181:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: '+Math.floor(fuel)+'%',10,40);
182:   }
183: 
184:   function loop(timestamp){
185:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
186:     lastTime = timestamp;
187:     update(dt);
188:     draw();
189:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
190:   }
191:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
192: })();

(End of file - total 192 lines)
